## Objective
- Expand the existing 100-floor browser RPG into a more complete game and fix the player-hand animation bug.

## Requirements
- Fix the character’s hand stretching downward.
- Add floors with more enemies, safe-zone floors, a shop, trading, healing items, ore drops, armor forging, and monster loot.
- Deliver a complete playable game.

## Decisions
- The existing game uses an original, canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the initial 100-floor RPG with combat, bosses, leveling, stats, potions, weapon drops, autosave, and responsive controls.
- Verified it renders and that attacking damages an enemy without browser runtime errors.

### Active
- The requested bug fixes and game-system expansion have not been started.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the current combat animation and fix the stretched hand/arm pose.

- Complete and validate the 100-floor browser RPG, including combat, services, persistence, the final boss, and responsive controls.

- Keep the existing canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.

- Let the player choose which stats receive points.
- Add a rarity system and NPC chatbots in safe rooms that can tell stories.

## Decisions
- Floors ending in 5 are safe waystations; floors divisible by 10 are boss floors.
- Stat points are allocated using per-stat `+` buttons rather than automatic rotation.
- NPC conversations and stories are implemented locally, without an external chatbot service.

- `game.js`: gameplay, persistence, stat allocation, relic drops, NPC dialogue, and rendering.
- `index.html`: stat controls, inventory rarity display, and NPC chat UI.

- Keep the existing canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.

## Objective
- Expand the vanilla browser RPG with thousands of distinct NPCs, local conversations and quests, and a working blacksmith.
- Support replaying unlocked floors without respawning defeated bosses, improve combat VFX, and preserve existing game systems.

## Requirements
- Keep the existing canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- NPC conversations must work locally without an external chatbot service.
- Preserve combat, waystation services, stat allocation, rarity, and persistence.

## Decisions
- Generate a procedural resident population with individual identities, routines, stories, and behaviors.
- Persist defeated bosses; revisited boss floors should spawn regular encounters instead.
- Add controls for returning to previously unlocked floors.

### Completed
- Added resident search/meet, details, quest controls, local chat, and floor selection/travel panels.
- Wired resident, quest, chat, and travel controls; removed the stale `.npc-choices` handler.

- `node --check game.js` passes.

- Test resident search, chat, quest completion, and persistence across reloads.
- Test forging through the service button and smith chat, including quest progress.
- Test floor travel, floor clears, and boss replay; check responsive layout and enhance combat VFX as needed.

- (none)

- `game.js`: Game state, residents, dialogue/quests, combat, persistence, travel, and canvas rendering.
- `index.html`: Resident and floor-travel controls.
- `style.css`: Layout, responsive styling, and combat effects.
- `README.md`: Game documentation.

- Add or improve combat shake/VFX; incoming-hit code adds the `shake` class, but no matching CSS effect was found.

- (none)

1. Run browser checks for resident, quest, smith/forge, persistence, travel, and boss replay flows.
2. Check responsive layout and add a reduced-motion-aware combat shake effect if appropriate.

- `game.js`: Game state, residents, dialogue/quests, combat, persistence, travel, and canvas rendering.
- `index.html`: Resident and floor-travel controls.
- `style.css`: Layout, responsive styling, and combat effects.
- `README.md`: Game documentation.
